record_title: Accelerated filtrations decouple algebraic entropy from affine growth
provenance: An explicit polynomial-ring filtration and a general acceleration construction separate filtered algebraic entropy from intrinsic affine-algebra growth, with a linear-control repair criterion.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Classical filtered-graded GK comparison results and their finite-generation hypotheses are prior art. Older re-filtering literature may contain equivalent filtration-growth observations under different terminology. No independent validation is asserted.
